purpose: Pre-market-data activity sanity check only; not performance evidence or a WTI probability claim.

statistic.demeaning: subtract arithmetic mean of all 48 observations
statistic.transform: length-48 DFT with no taper and no zero padding
statistic.one_sided_weighting: 2*abs(DFT[k])^2 for k=1..23; abs(DFT[24])^2 for the unpaired Nyquist bin
statistic.formula: H=-sum(p[k]*ln(p[k]))/ln(24), with zero-power bin contribution defined as zero

boundaries: No market prices, returns, EA reports, or optimizer output were read.
The 0.88 boundary was locked from the market-free cadence requirement, not fitted to WTI.
The null is not asserted to describe WTI.
Q02 owns actual activity and economics.
